population: Same customers assigned Mens E-Mail or No E-Mail, preserving original row order; condition on pair membership and realized treatment counts.
Y: visit: any website visit in following two weeks, 0/1
spend: dollars spent in following two weeks

small.label: Recency and spending
small.purpose: Purchase timing and spending amount; existing small X.

large.label: Recency, spending, categories
large.purpose: Add prior purchase categories; existing large X.

history_newbie.label: Recency, spending, new customer
history_newbie.purpose: Add new-customer status to purchase timing and amount.

combined.purpose: Jointly add prior purchase categories and new-customer status to the common purchase-timing and spending base; additive terms only.

W_policy: Exactly the same original 12-column W matrix for every X; no new auxiliary features or interactions. The residual score vector X_i times outcome residual depends on X mechanically.

features.mens: Purchased mens merchandise during past year, 0/1
features.womens: Purchased womens merchandise during past year, 0/1
features.newbie: New customer during past twelve months, 0/1
features.zip: Urban/Suburban/Rural; Rural reference; source spells Surburban
features.channel: Past-year purchase channel; Multichannel reference; Phone and Web indicators
features.interactions: recency_by_newbie and log1p_history_by_newbie multiply standardized original recency/log-history by raw newbie, then center/scale as before

preprocessing: Match original finite-population preprocessing: all nonconstant columns centered/scaled over same full selected population, ddof=0; preserve original interaction construction. No outcome transformation, trimming, imputation or sample changes.
interpretation: X defines linear projections of individual treatment effects and changes the relationship estimands. W assists estimation at each fixed X. Real-data causal truth remains unknown.
inference: Original joint outcome-major conservative coefficient covariance with nz-1 normalization; delta-method normal 95% intervals, untruncated; every X reported.
failure_policy: Every X and both methods reported; undefined outputs retained with defined=false.
